title: MSlenejennum/647452/new header and footer layouts and report themes
summary: New composite report parts management codeunit seeds 11 header/footer designs and 3 themes into the shared Tenant Report Defaults pool on install and upgrade, overwriting tenant edits to shipped content.
key_points: Introduces codeunit 9667 'Composite Report Parts Mgt.' to manage predefined report layout parts
Adds 14 docx and dotx resources for header/footer designs and report themes
Seeding process runs on every upgrade to ensure shipped parts always reflect app content
Unshipped parts are removed and their assignments cleared automatically
Resource read failures are logged to telemetry without aborting install or upgrade
